description: Turn a written policy into rules a program can check, and get the same answer every time.
name: jaxon

plugins.description: Check documents and AI output against written policy. DSAIL turns a written policy, like a compliance manual, filed rating rules, insurance policy wording or a release standard, into a ruleset and records the rule behind every result. Use it for policy compliance, eligibility, rating and claims checks. It applies the rules a policy already states; it does not decide who may act or who signs off.
plugins.displayName: DSAIL: Decision Rules from Written Policy
